business: Hollywood Smile Dental Center (ATOS Medical Center)
summary: A Doha cosmetic dental centre appears to lose smile makeover enquiries because there is no booking form and proof is thin.

findings.problem: The Book An Appointment section appears to give only a phone number and email, with no form or booking button.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book have to call or write, and many will not.

findings.problem: Contact Us and Call Us Now appear to point to the same anchor, and header and footer links for the same services appear to use different addresses.
findings.cost: Confusing links send patients to the wrong place.
findings.fix: Consistent links and a clear primary button.

findings.problem: The testimonials page address appears to be spelled testimonails, and the page appears as both Dental Center and Dental Clinic.
findings.cost: Typos and mixed names weaken trust.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one brand name.

findings.problem: The stats such as 99+ satisfaction and 16+ honorary awards appear to name no source, and no before and after photos or dentist credentials appear.
findings.cost: High value patients want visible results and credentials.
findings.fix: A results gallery, named dentists and sourced stats.
